lines.text_source: Don't mind the chief. We left our home halfway through his training.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.intent: dismiss concern about chief's absence with exaggerated reassurance
lines.base_translation: Não se preocupe com o chefe. A gente saiu de casa no meio do treinamento dele.

lines.text_source: There's several lifetime's worth of work here. Baydral certainly hasn't beaten about the kelp. I hope he doesn't mind if we make a bit of a mess of it.
lines.speaker: Balof
lines.intent: express overwhelm at task scope and hope for patience, with characteristic exaggeration
lines.base_translation: Tem trabalho aqui pra várias vidas! O Baydral com certeza não foi com jeito. Espero que ele não se importe a gente bagunçar um pouco.
lines.risk_notes: 'beaten about the kelp' is idiomatic/playful (EN fishing pun); localized to Brazilian equivalent energy. 'não foi com jeito' preserves the sense of directness without literal translation. Hyperbolism (lifetime's worth) matches Balof's voice profile.

lines.text_source: It looks like Baydral wanted to use that orb's power to burst the dam. I can't imagine what drove him to want to do such a thing.
lines.speaker: Brigard
lines.intent: analyze situation with stoic concern; state factual observation about motive mystery
lines.base_translation: Parece que Baydral queria usar o poder daquele orbe pra arrombar a barragem. Não consigo imaginar o que o levou a querer fazer uma coisa assim.
lines.risk_notes: Brigard's voice = short clipped sentences, no sentimentalism, military formality. 'I can't imagine' risks softening into colloquial PT-BR; kept formal ('Não consigo imaginar') to preserve starkness. Lore-critical line: Baydral's motive (spoiler setup — 'what drove him'). Back-translation required: EN 'burst the dam' → PT-BR 'arrombar/explodir a barragem' (chose 'arrombar' for Brigard's dry, forceful register). No identity doubts; speaker is clearly Brigard from context.
